## Summary
<!-- What changes and why, in 1-3 sentences. A reviewer should get the intent without opening the diff. -->

## Type
- [ ] `feat`: new feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore`: build, dependencies, CI, config

## Changes
<!-- Notable changes as bullets; link files or commits where useful. -->
- 

## Verification
<!-- Commands run and what you observed; screenshots for UI. "Not tested" is valid; say why. -->

## Risk and rollback
<!-- Breaking changes, secret or data exposure, blast radius, and how to undo. Write "None" if trivial. -->

## Follow-ups
<!-- Manual steps after merge, dependent PRs in other repos, deferred work. -->

## Related
<!-- Closes #123 / Depends on owner/repo#45 -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Breaking changes called out above
